meta.description: PV-D28. Daily 09:00 Asia/Makassar: read-and-remind, never decide. clients.list -> per client contracts.list + invoicePayments.list (via the hub, clientId in the path) -> collect (a) payment claims status=pending recorded >2 days ago, (b) contracts status=sent that the client signed and we have not (clientSigned && !providerSigned) sent >1 day ago, (c) contracts status=sent with clientSigned=false sent >7 days ago. If none qualify the run stops silently. Otherwise ONE in-app digest (counts + client names, linking /clients/<id>/billing) via the hub `notify` tool, delivered once per recipient id in BILLING_NOTIFY_USER_IDS (comma list; falls back to NOTIFY_USER_ID, the ops lead): `notify` takes a single recipientId and the allow-list has no owner lookup, so the owners / client account owners are CONFIGURED, not resolved. It never sends, countersigns, confirms or rejects (those stay human, or agent-behind-D14). Scoped identity wf:billing-chaser -> [clients.list, contracts.list, invoicePayments.list, notify]; the platform service account is a manager (reads contract/invoice/client, notify). Env: HUB_SERVICE_TOKEN, AGENCY_TENANT_ID, BILLING_NOTIFY_USER_IDS or NOTIFY_USER_ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "clients.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "contracts.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, clientId: $json.clientId } } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "invoicePayments.list", arguments: { tenantId: $env.AGENCY_TENANT_ID, clientId: $json.clientId } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: "2.0", id: 1, method: "tools/call", params: { name: "notify", arguments: { tenantId: $json.tenantId, recipientId: $json.recipientId, type: "billing_chaser_digest", payload: $json.payload } } }) }}
